Page layout and publishing
for the web and the desktop
What it is
A page-layout application for magazines, books, reports, print and websites.
It is made for people and their agents. Drop content on the Make panel, write a brief, pick a template and press Make layout, then refine the result in a full editor.
The layout core is FormDesign's own Rust engine with 394 commands and 41 tools, and the interface comes in 26 languages.
Available on macOS, Windows and Linux

blocks.k: From a brief to a layout

blocks.text: The Make pass

Intake reads your files and brief for kind, size, page count, tone, colours and brand. The Make pass ranks templates, fills them, threads the article through continuation pages, matches images to frames, fits copy and reports what is still sample text.
71 templates across magazine, newsletter, book, report, print, ad and web.
Turns Markdown, Word, RTF, text, HTML, CSV, spreadsheets, PDFs, images and a plain-words brief into one content pack. Text is composed with a Knuth-Plass paragraph composer.
